wh_main_unit_abilities_blooood.tooltip: The Hellcannon breaks its chains and rushes forwards. Increased movement speed.

wh_main_spell_bound_book_of_arkhan.tooltip: Friendly units targeted by the caster are filled with magical energy, making them even more aggressive!

wh2_main_item_abilities_book_of_hoeth.tooltip: This tome has been studied throughout the ages, yet its covers remain as blue and pristine as the day it was bound.

wh3_dlc24_item_abilities_book_of_secrets.tooltip: Fire, Death and Shadow; all parts of a balanced, nutritious breakfast. Mmmm…

wh_dlc03_character_abilities_call_of_vio.tooltip: We feel it. We all feel it. The pull to war. The tug of battle. The NEED to kill.

wh_dlc03_item_abilities_chalice_of_dark_.tooltip: Made from the skull of a geomancer - when filled with soil, the chalice can summon a deluge of blood-soaked mud.

wh_main_item_abilities_channelling_staff.tooltip: A staff of pure silver etched with all eight runes from the magic wheel. Such an item can only enhance a Wizard's ability to channel.

wh_main_weapon_abilities_charmed_shield.tooltip: The front of this shield depicts a warrior being blessed by a nameless lady. Its wielder gains protection from the sigil, especially against foes armed with missiles.

wh2_main_character_abilities_cold_bloode.tooltip: While Lizardmen may be slow to react due to their cold-blooded nature, this also makes them stoic in battle.

wh_main_item_abilities_crown_of_command.tooltip: The Crown of Command has been worn in countless battles. Its wearer is given great authority, instilling in his subjects an unbreakable courage.

wh2_main_item_abilities_cube_of_darkness.tooltip: This small black cube contains millions of tiny pin-pricks of light circling around a sphere of pure darkness.

wh2_dlc09_character_abilities_curse_of_k.tooltip: The harsh, howling desert winds cut through everything, be it armour or clothing or raw flesh.

wh3_dlc27_character_abilities_slezuzus_v.tooltip: A Daemonic presence seems to influence Styrkaar and those around him, bending their will to give him thanks and praise even as he disembowels them.

wh_main_item_abilities_dark_fortune.tooltip: Asavar Kul, the Butcher of Praag, demanded his Champions sup boiled Daemon blood from the Chalice of Chaos, imbuing them with strength and vigour.

wh3_dlc25_lord_abilities_deranged_muniti.tooltip: The experiments might look like madness, but the results unleash devastating firepower.

wh2_dlc15_lord_abilities_dont_even_try_i.tooltip: Goblins, in general, are a little twitchy to say the least. If you’ve flinched too soon, you’re probably already dead.

wh3_dlc27_spell_bound_runecaller_death_d.tooltip: Spirits of the departed assail the Wizard’s foes, sapping their resolve and causing dread among their numbers.

wh_dlc08_spell_bound_death_doom_and_dark.tooltip: Spirits of the departed assail the Wizard’s foes, sapping their resolve and causing dread among their numbers.

wh3_dlc29_lord_abilities_doom_lord.tooltip: I do not fear death, for it answers to me!

wh_main_item_abilities_earthing_rod.tooltip: When planted in the ground this obsidian rod becalms the arcane winds for the briefest moment, allowing the Wizard to cast one of his powerful enchantments unopposed.

wh_dlc05_weapon_abilities_el_syf.tooltip: The so-called 'Northern Sword' fears no duel; anyone who dares confront him will surely meet their death!

wh2_dlc09_item_abilities_elixir_of_might.tooltip: One sip of the elixir fills the body of its drinker with the strength of many powerful, elite warriors.

wh2_main_spell_bound_embers_of_the_phoen.tooltip: The Wizard ensorcels allied weapons, making them burn with a savage fire. Friendly targets are augmented with superior flaming blades.

wh2_dlc11_character_abilities_ballistic_.tooltip: These particular balls give the shooter a magical advantage over their targets.

wh3_dlc29_item_abilities_enhanced_skaven.tooltip: This concoction is made of Warpstone and the blood of many different creatures, making its effects even more devastating.

wh2_dlc10_character_abilities_entangle.tooltip: A thicket of briars will entangle the enemy, covering them in dry, flammable foliage.

wh_main_unit_abilities_entrenchment.tooltip: All the sons of Grungni can dig-in, enabling them to better resist physical attacks from the foe. Any missile attacks they can make are also improved.

ui_bullets: Does not affect units with immunity to Terror.
wh3_dlc29_lord_abilities_gaze_of_usirian.tooltip: To a mighty Liche, death is never the end. It is a terrifying, debilitating prospect held entire in a Liche's hollow gaze.

wh3_dlc29_character_abilities_eternal_vi.tooltip: It is hard to strike one whose cloak carries them through the veil between worlds.

wh3_main_character_abilities_extra_ingre.tooltip: A little bit of this, a pinch of that, and a touch of the other and... stand well back!

wh2_dlc10_item_abilities_fear_of_aramar.tooltip: A scroll describing a dread spell that fills the foes' minds with images from their own worst nightmares!

wh3_dlc24_unit_abilities_fearsome_roar.tooltip: This one's bark is at least as bad as their bite…

wh3_dlc29_character_active_mark_of_the_m.tooltip: A host of Daemon Flies plunges down the ailing beast's throat, laying a thousand eggs. The wriggling larvae nestle among the lungs, guts, and heart – chewing the three-pocked mark through their innards, heralding the agonised birth of a creature darker still.

wh2_dlc15_lord_abilities_fermented_fungi.tooltip: Rotten mushroom gas wafted towards the enemy can cause them to lose their mind at the worst possible moment in battle.

wh_dlc08_lord_abilities_fight_or_die.tooltip: There is no other choice. There never was.

wh3_main_item_abilities_fistful_of_laure.tooltip: Ogres don't believe in declaring their leadership qualities via trinkets, but that doesn't mean they're above robbing the dead if it inspires their forces to push even harder.

wh2_dlc16_spell_bound_flesh_to_stone.tooltip: This spell temporarily transforms allies' mortal flesh into unbreakable rock, increasing tenfold their resistance to attack.

wh2_dlc12_lord_abilities_focus_instincts.tooltip: By which the mind is concentrated on the task at hand, allowing it to be carried out effectively whilst keeping passion and abandon firmly in check.

wh_main_item_abilities_forbidden_rod.tooltip: This marble and golden-laced artefact can summon the Winds of Magic, but at a cost to the user.

wh3_dlc27_qb_unit_abilities_frenzied_cha.tooltip: Faced with this creature's challenge, one either fights or flees. Yet who would flee and doom themselves to nightmares of becoming its meal? Fight it is.

wh3_main_weapon_abilities_frost_shard_gl.tooltip: The frost shard blade of this revered weapon sparkles with the cold, hard promise of sharp slaughter.

wh2_dlc13_lord_abilities_funnel_of_flame.tooltip: As they careen and stagger about, their flesh irreparably charred beyond recognition, perhaps the foe will rue the day they made war on the Empire?

wh3_main_lord_abilities_gaze_of_fate.tooltip: Sometimes, the abyss stares right back at you, and true perspective is revealed. The shock freezes the foe where they stand.

wh3_dlc25_character_abilities_get_em.tooltip: Don't just stand there like a pig-kissa! Get 'Em!

wh_main_character_abilities_get_back_ere.tooltip: Da Boss ain't ready to run an' so expects da boyz to stay put too!

wh3_main_weapon_abilities_soulnetter.tooltip: This blade of Gilellion the Lewd, champion of Slaanesh, traps its victims in immortal servitude to its bearer.

wh3_twa08_unit_abilities_glacial_defence.tooltip: An icy carapace surrounds the Stonehorn, slowing the lumbering beast down further while adding a layer of natural armour to their defences.

wh3_dlc29_hero_active_glory_seeker.tooltip: Meeting the gaze of Orghotts Daemonspew is enough to render a creature numb, such is the malice behind his eyes

wh3_main_item_abilities_gruts_sickle.tooltip: Grut the Bloodthirsty's culinary malevolence seems to live on in his rusty sickle, which gives the Butcher greater command over the Winds, but at a cost to his own health.

wh3_dlc27_qb_unit_abilities_guttural_roa.tooltip: This is not a warning for evildoers to go. It is a promise of what is to come.

wh_dlc03_item_abilities_hagtree_fetish.tooltip: A crude effigy and shamanic heirloom from one of the hag trees that grow deep in the forest.

wh2_dlc13_lord_abilities_hail_of_fire.tooltip: It may be cruel, but the power to burn the foe to ash is extremely useful when you want to be sure of winning.

wh3_dlc26_character_abilities_headhunt.tooltip: Promising a bonus for each and every skull detached, whether or not its owner objects, has proved to be something of a motivator among Ogre mercenaries.
